newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HUVITUSFOND 9TH ISSUE BID PRICE 313 EVP-KROONS.
newsitem.headline: HUVITUSFOND 9TH ISSUE BID PRICE 313 EVP-KROONS.

text.p: Huvitusfond said on Tuesday that their ninth series obligation issue will have a minimum bid price of 313 Estonian privatisation voucher kroons (EVP).
Bids under the 313 EVP-kroons minimum will not be considered.
In a statement Huvitusfond said that the first issue of the ninth series will begin on May 21 and will end on June 18.
The current official value of EVP is 0.276 kroons, according to an official at Huvitusfond.
EVPs are securities with a nominal value in kroons given as part of a compensation system for property reform and number of years worked.
